title: Home page
summary: Required landing page at /home. Enable cannot be turned off. Hosts PluginSlots for FAQ, onboarding, and featured.

blocks.title: Page plugin
blocks.text: package.json tuucho.kind page, route /home. This plugin mounts the home React page. While enabled, the kernel puts the route on the shop menu (nav.key / order). Disable and the URL and menu entry go away.

items.description: While Sitemap pages is on, the kernel lists this route on seo.sitemap.entries. Extra paths that are not this route must register the filter yourself (Guides does /pose and /capsules).

blocks.text: required: true. Do not copy this folder to add a new page; copy plugins/user/demo/guides/page-guides instead.
